paper_readiness.strongest_residue: Typed context primitives + prospective intervention grammar + cross-domain repository-native interaction transport
paper_readiness.blocker: Need broader non-bot software-design transport before a macro-law manuscript is credible.

principle_as_projection_hypothesis.statement: A named design principle may be a low-description-length local projection of a richer interaction-conditioned policy Pi(X,G,E), not a primitive law.
falsifiers: Named principles remain stable across broad states without interaction-conditioned qualification.
The four primitive/context geometry fails to predict non-bot design actions beyond migration/workflow mechanisms.
A simpler rival representation predicts action and reversals with equal or better cross-domain transport.
